name: Differentiable Bitmap Splatting
definition: A scalable differentiable rendering engine for a collection of bitmap images that optimizes position, rotation, scale, color, and opacity of thousands of bitmap primitives using custom CUDA kernels for forward and backward passes.
summary: Differentiable Bitmap Splatting optimizes raster image parameters using CUDA, enabling diverse semi-transparent compositions unlike prior vector-only or opaque bitmap methods.
